# Components/Navigation/Drawer

## Metadata

- id: drawer
- type: story
- route: /docs/drawer
- title: Components/Navigation/Drawer
- component: FktDrawerComponent
- import: `import { FktDrawerComponent } from 'frakton-ng/drawer';`

## Description

The FktDrawer component provides a slide-out navigation panel that can either push content aside or overlay on top of it. Built with Angular signals and modern design patterns, it offers flexible positioning and smooth animations.

## Features

### Push

- id: push
- type: story
- component: PushExampleComponent

Drawer in push mode that displaces the main content when opened.

Example component: `PushExampleComponent`

```ts title="push-example.component.ts"
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FktDrawerComponent } from 'frakton-ng/drawer';
import { FktIconComponent } from 'frakton-ng/icon';

@Component({
  selector: 'fkt-drawer-push-example',
  imports: [FktDrawerComponent, FktIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './push-example.component.html',
  styleUrl: './push-example.component.scss'
})
export class PushExampleComponent {
  opened = signal(false);

  toggleDrawer() {
    this.opened.set(!this.opened());
  }
}
```


### Overlay

- id: overlay
- type: story
- component: OverlayExampleComponent

Drawer in overlay mode that floats over the content with backdrop.

Example component: `OverlayExampleComponent`

```ts title="overlay-example.component.ts"
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FktDrawerComponent } from 'frakton-ng/drawer';
import { FktIconComponent } from 'frakton-ng/icon';

@Component({
  selector: 'fkt-drawer-overlay-example',
  imports: [FktDrawerComponent, FktIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './overlay-example.component.html',
  styleUrl: './overlay-example.component.scss'
})
export class OverlayExampleComponent {
  opened = signal(false);

  toggleDrawer() {
    this.opened.set(!this.opened());
  }

  onBackdropClick() {
    this.opened.set(false);
  }
}
```

```css title="overlay-example.component.scss"
.overlay-example {
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 500px;
  position: relative;

  .drawer-content {
    background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
    height: 100%;
    box-shadow: var(--fkt-shadow-xl);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    .drawer-header {
      padding: var(--fkt-space-lg);
      background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
      color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;

      h3 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-lg);
        font-weight: var(--fkt-font-semibold);
      }

      .close-btn {
        background: none;
        border: none;
        color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 0;
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-full);
        transition: var(--fkt-transition-base);

        &:hover {
          background: var(--fkt-color-neutral-400);
        }
      }
    }

    .drawer-body {
      flex: 1;
      padding: var(--fkt-space-lg);
      overflow-y: auto;

      .action-group {
        margin-bottom: var(--fkt-space-xl);

        &:last-child {
          margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        h4 {
          margin: 0 0 var(--fkt-space-sm) 0;
          color: var(--fkt-color-text-base);
          font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-sm);
          font-weight: var(--fkt-font-semibold);
          text-transform: uppercase;
          letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .action-item {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: var(--fkt-space-sm);
          padding: var(--fkt-space-sm) var(--fkt-space-md);
          color: var(--fkt-color-text-muted);
          text-decoration: none;
          border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-md);
          margin-bottom: var(--fkt-space-3xs);
          transition: var(--fkt-transition-base);
          border: 1px solid transparent;

          fkt-icon {
            color: var(--fkt-color-info);
          }

          &:hover {
            background: var(--fkt-color-neutral-300);
            border-color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-200);
            color: var(--fkt-color-text-base);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  .main-content {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--fkt-color-neutral-background);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    .header {
      padding: var(--fkt-space-lg);
      background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
      color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--fkt-space-md);

      .toggle-btn {
        padding: var(--fkt-space-xs) var(--fkt-space-md);
        background: var(--fkt-color-neutral-300);
        border: none;
        color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
        border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-sm);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: var(--fkt-transition-base);
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--fkt-space-xs);

        &:hover {
          background: var(--fkt-color-neutral-400);
        }
      }

      h2 {
        margin: 0;
        font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-2xl);
        font-weight: var(--fkt-font-semibold);
      }
    }

    .content {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 24px;

      p {
        margin: 0 0 16px 0;
        line-height: 1.6;
        color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-600);
      }

      .feature-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
        gap: 20px;
        margin-top: 24px;

        .feature-card {
          background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
          padding: var(--fkt-space-lg);
          border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-lg);
          box-shadow: var(--fkt-shadow-md);
          border-left: 4px solid var(--fkt-color-info);
          transition: var(--fkt-transition-base);

          &:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--fkt-shadow-lg);
          }

          .card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--fkt-space-sm);
            margin-bottom: var(--fkt-space-sm);

            fkt-icon {
              color: var(--fkt-color-info);
            }
          }

          h4 {
            margin: 0;
            color: var(--fkt-color-text-base);
            font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-md);
            font-weight: var(--fkt-font-semibold);
          }

          p {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-sm);
            color: var(--fkt-color-text-muted);
            line-height: var(--fkt-line-height-md);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```ts title="opened-example.component.ts"
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
```

```css title="opened-example.component.scss"
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                gap: var(--fkt-space-xs);

                &:hover {
                    background: var(--fkt-color-accent-opacity-30);
                }
            }

            h2 {
                margin: 0;
                font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-2xl);
                font-weight: var(--fkt-font-semibold);
            }
        }

        .content {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 24px;

            .welcome-card {
                background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
                padding: 24px;
                border-radius: 8px;
                box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
                margin-bottom: 24px;
                border-left: 4px solid #e94560;

                h3 {
                    margin: 0 0 12px 0;
                    color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
                    font-size: 20px;
                }

                p {
                    margin: 0;
                    line-height: 1.6;
                    color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-600);
                }
            }

            .stats-grid {
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
                gap: 16px;

                .stat-card {
                    background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
                    padding: 24px;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
                    text-align: center;
                    transition: transform 0.2s ease;

                    &:hover {
                        transform: translateY(-2px);
                    }

                    .stat-value {
                        font-size: 32px;
                        font-weight: 700;
                        color: #e94560;
                        margin-bottom: 8px;
                    }

                    .stat-label {
                        font-size: 14px;
                        color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
                        text-transform: uppercase;
                        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### Wide

- id: wide
- type: story
- component: WideExampleComponent

Drawer with wider width for more content and better readability.

Example component: `WideExampleComponent`

```ts title="wide-example.component.ts"
import { Component, signal, computed } from '@angular/core';
import { FktDrawerComponent } from 'frakton-ng/drawer';
import { FktIconComponent } from 'frakton-ng/icon';

@Component({
  selector: 'fkt-drawer-wide-example',
  imports: [FktDrawerComponent, FktIconComponent],
  templateUrl: './wide-example.component.html',
  styleUrl: './wide-example.component.scss'
})
export class WideExampleComponent {
  opened = signal(false);
  selectedCategory = signal('all');

  categories = [
    { id: 'all', name: 'All Products', count: 156 },
    { id: 'electronics', name: 'Electronics', count: 42 },
    { id: 'clothing', name: 'Clothing', count: 38 },
    { id: 'books', name: 'Books', count: 28 },
    { id: 'home', name: 'Home & Garden', count: 31 },
    { id: 'sports', name: 'Sports & Outdoors', count: 17 }
  ];

  selectedCategoryName = computed(() => {
    const category = this.categories.find(c => c.id === this.selectedCategory());
    return category?.name || 'All Products';
  });

  toggleDrawer() {
    this.opened.set(!this.opened());
  }

  selectCategory(categoryId: string) {
    this.selectedCategory.set(categoryId);
  }
}
```

### Narrow

- id: narrow
- type: story
- component: NarrowExampleComponent

Compact drawer with minimal width for icon-based navigation.

Example component: `NarrowExampleComponent`

```ts title="narrow-example.component.ts"
import { Component, computed, model, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { FktDrawerComponent } from 'frakton-ng/drawer';
import { FktIconComponent, FktIconName } from 'frakton-ng/icon';

@Component({
    selector: 'fkt-drawer-narrow-example',
    imports: [FktDrawerComponent, FktIconComponent],
    templateUrl: './narrow-example.component.html',
    styleUrl: './narrow-example.component.scss'
})
export class NarrowExampleComponent {
    mode = model('push');
    width = model('200px');
    opened = model(false);
    activeIcon = signal('home');

    menuItems: {id: string; icon: FktIconName; label: string}[] = [
        {id: 'home', icon: 'home', label: 'Home'},
        {id: 'profile', icon: 'user', label: 'Profile'},
        {id: 'messages', icon: 'chat-bubble-left', label: 'Messages'},
        {id: 'notifications', icon: 'bell', label: 'Notifications'},
        {id: 'settings', icon: 'cog-6-tooth', label: 'Settings'},
        {id: 'help', icon: 'question-mark-circle', label: 'Help'}
    ];

    activeIconLabel = computed(() => {
        const item = this.menuItems.find(item => item.id === this.activeIcon());
        return item?.label || 'Home';
    });

    toggleDrawer() {
        this.opened.set(!this.opened());
    }

    selectItem(itemId: string) {
        this.activeIcon.set(itemId);
    }
}
```

```css title="narrow-example.component.scss"
                transition: var(--fkt-transition-base);

                &:hover {
                    background: var(--fkt-color-danger-opacity-20);
                    color: var(--fkt-color-danger);
                    transform: scale(1.1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    .main-content {
        flex: 1;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        height: 100%;
        background: var(--fkt-color-neutral-background);
        min-width: 0;

        .header {
            padding: var(--fkt-space-md) var(--fkt-space-xl);
            background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
            color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: var(--fkt-space-md);

            .toggle-btn {
                width: 36px;
                height: 36px;
                background: var(--fkt-color-primary-opacity-20);
                border: none;
                color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
                border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-md);
                cursor: pointer;
                transition: var(--fkt-transition-base);
                font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-md);
                display: flex;
                align-items: center;
                justify-content: center;

                &:hover {
                    background: var(--fkt-color-primary-opacity-40);
                    transform: scale(1.05);
                }
            }

            h2 {
                margin: 0;
                font-size: 20px;
                font-weight: 600;
                flex: 1;
            }

            .header-info {
                font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-sm);
                color: var(--fkt-color-primary-opacity-80);
                padding: var(--fkt-space-2xs) var(--fkt-space-sm);
                background: var(--fkt-color-primary-opacity-20);
                border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-sm);
            }
        }

        .content {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 24px;

            .hero-section {
                text-align: center;
                margin-bottom: 32px;

                h3 {
                    margin: 0 0 12px 0;
                    font-size: 24px;
                    color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
                }

                p {
                    font-size: 16px;
                    color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-700);
                    line-height: 1.6;
                    max-width: 600px;
                    margin: 0 auto;
                }
            }

            .features-section {
                display: grid;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
                gap: 20px;
                margin-bottom: 32px;

                .feature-title {
                    display: flex;
                    gap: var(--fkt-space-xs);
                    justify-content: center;
                }

                .feature-item {
                    text-align: center;
                    padding: 20px;
                    background: var(--fkt-color-card-background);
                    border-radius: 12px;
                    box-shadow: var(--fkt-shadow-md);
                    border: 1px solid var(--fkt-color-neutral-300);
                    transition: transform 0.2s ease;

                    &:hover {
                        transform: translateY(-4px);
                    }

                    .feature-icon {
                        font-size: 32px;
                        margin-bottom: 12px;
                    }

                    h4 {
                        margin: 0 0 8px 0;
                        font-size: 16px;
                        color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-900);
                        font-weight: 600;
                    }

                    p {
                        margin: 0;
                        font-size: 14px;
                        color: var(--fkt-color-neutral-700);
                        line-height: 1.4;
                    }
                }
            }

            .content-area {
                .content-card {
                    background: var(--fkt-color-modal-background);
                    padding: var(--fkt-space-xl);
                    border-radius: var(--fkt-radius-xl);
                    box-shadow: var(--fkt-shadow-lg);
                    border-left: 4px solid var(--fkt-color-accent);

                    .content-header {
                        display: flex;
                        align-items: center;
                        gap: var(--fkt-space-sm);
                        margin-bottom: var(--fkt-space-sm);

                        fkt-icon {
                            color: var(--fkt-color-accent);
                        }
                    }

                    h4 {
                        margin: 0;
                        font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-xl);
                        color: var(--fkt-color-text-base);
                        font-weight: var(--fkt-font-semibold);
                    }

                    p {
                        margin: 0;
                        line-height: var(--fkt-line-height-md);
                        color: var(--fkt-color-text-muted);
                        font-size: var(--fkt-font-size-md);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## API Reference

## Key Features

- **Dual Display Modes**: Push mode (displaces content) and overlay mode (floats over content)
- **Configurable Width**: Customizable drawer width to fit content needs
- **Smooth Animations**: CSS-based transitions for opening and closing
- **Backdrop Support**: Optional backdrop with click-to-close functionality in overlay mode
- **Signal-Based**: Built with Angular signals for optimal performance
- **Responsive Design**: Adapts to different screen sizes and orientations
- **Event Handling**: Comprehensive event system for user interactions

## Configuration Options

### Types

```typescript
export type FktDrawerTypes = 'overlay' | 'push';
```

<arg-types></arg-types>

## Use Cases

- **Navigation Menus**: Primary and secondary navigation interfaces
- **Settings Panels**: Application configuration and user preferences
- **Filters and Search**: Advanced filtering and search interfaces
- **Shopping Carts**: E-commerce cart and checkout processes
- **Document Outlines**: Content navigation and table of contents
- **Toolbar Extensions**: Additional tools and options

## Accessibility

- **Keyboard Navigation**: Full keyboard support with Tab and Escape keys
- **Focus Management**: Proper focus handling when drawer opens/closes
- **Screen Reader Support**: Appropriate ARIA attributes and announcements
- **Color Contrast**: High contrast support for visual accessibility
- **Motion Preferences**: Respects user's reduced motion preferences
- **Touch Friendly**: Optimized for touch interactions on mobile devices

## Performance

- **Efficient Animations**: Hardware-accelerated CSS transitions
- **Signal-Based Updates**: Optimized change detection with Angular signals
- **Memory Management**: Proper cleanup of event listeners and subscriptions
- **Responsive Rendering**: Efficient handling of viewport changes
